body: Coordinator rule (Termal::Fable2, 2026-10-20 04:27Z, my own miss). While a session's full gate runs, give that session NO task that runs shell commands: no Mac or SSH checks, no remote-proxy dispatch, no diagnostics, even when the cwd is MAIN or another host. Darwin's gate test-fc235f30 was refused credit ("this session ran a pwsh command there") after I asked Sol-1cee to check its Mac channel and dispatch S3 step 1 mid-gate. That cost a 20-minute gate. Give side work to a different session, or wait for the settled record.
